44928-the-liberty-girl.title: Liberty Girl
44928-the-liberty-girl.creator: Rena I. Halsey
44928-the-liberty-girl.description: A book by Rena I. Halsey. “Oh, Nathalie, I do believe there’s Grace Tyson in her new motor-car,” exclaimed Helen Dame, suddenly laying her hand on her companion’s arm as the two girls were about to cross Main Street, the wide, tree-lined thoroughfare of the old-fashioned town of Westport, Long Island.

arxiv-1905-09833.title: Dynamical origin of flavor hierarchies in a warped extra dimension
arxiv-1905-09833.creator: Aqeel Ahmed, Adrian Carmona, Javier Castellano Ruiz, Yi Chung, and Matthias Neubert
arxiv-1905-09833.description: Abstract Extensions of the Standard Model featuring a warped extra dimension compactified on an S 1 / ℤ 2 S^{1}/\mathbb{Z}_{2} orbifold, in which the fermions and gauge bosons live in the bulk of the fifth dimension, offer one of the most compelling mechanisms for addressing both the hierarchy problem and the flavor puzzle of the Standard Model.

arxiv-1909-09705.title: A Layered Architecture for Active Perception: Image Classification using Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-1909-09705.creator: Hossein K. Mousavi, Guangyi Liu, Weihang Yuan, Martin Takác̆, Héctor Muñoz-Avila, Nader Motee
arxiv-1909-09705.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Hossein K. Mousavi, Guangyi Liu, Weihang Yuan, Martin Takác̆, Héctor Muñoz-Avila, Nader Motee. We propose a planning and perception mechanism for a robot (agent), that can only observe the underlying environment partially, in order to solve an image classification problem. A three-layer architecture is suggested that consists of a meta-layer that decides the intermediate goals, an action-layer that selects local actions as the agent navigates towards a goal, and a classification-layer that evaluates the reward and makes a prediction.

arxiv-2304-03640.title: FedDiSC: A Computation-efficient Federated Learning Framework for Power Systems Disturbance and Cyber Attack Discrimination
arxiv-2304-03640.creator: Muhammad Akbar Husnoo, Adnan Anwar, Haftu Tasew Reda, Nasser Hosseinzadeh, Shama Naz Islam, Abdun Naser Mahmood, Robin Doss
arxiv-2304-03640.description: Abstract With the growing concern about the security and privacy of smart grid systems, cyberattacks on critical power grid components, such as state estimation, have proven to be one of the top-priority cyber-related issues and have received significant attention in recent years.

arxiv-2304-10323.title: CLT for β \beta -ensembles at high-temperature, and for integrable systems: a transfer operator approach.
arxiv-2304-10323.creator: G. Mazzuca, R. Memin
arxiv-2304-10323.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove a polynomial Central Limit Theorem for several integrable models, and for the β \beta -ensembles at high-temperature with polynomial potential. Furthermore, we connect the mean values, the variances and the correlations of the moments of the Lax matrices of these integrable systems with the ones of the β \beta -ensembles.

arxiv-2308-13304.title: Rapid Artefact Removal and H&E-Stained Tissue Segmentation
arxiv-2308-13304.creator: B. A. Schreiber, J. Denholm, F. Jaeckle, M. J. Arends, K. M. Branson, C.-B. Schönlieb, E. J. Soilleux
arxiv-2308-13304.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by B. A. Schreiber, J. Denholm, F. Jaeckle, M. J. Arends, K. M. Branson, C.-B. Schönlieb, E. J. Soilleux. We present an innovative method for rapidly segmenting hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained tissue in whole-slide images (WSIs) that eliminates a wide range of undesirable artefacts such as pen marks and scanning artefacts.

arxiv-2310-14665.title: Read Disturbance in High Bandwidth Memory: A Detailed Experimental Study on HBM2 DRAM Chips
arxiv-2310-14665.creator: Ataberk Olgun 1 Majd Osseiran 1 A. Giray Yağlıkçı 1 Yahya Can Tuğrul 1 Haocong Luo 1 Steve Rhyner 1 Behzad Salami 2 Juan Gomez Luna 1 Onur Mutlu 1 1 ETH Zürich 2 BSC

Detailed characterization of six real HBM2 DRAM chips in two different FPGA boards shows that (1) the read disturbance vulnerability significantly varies between different HBM2 chips and between different components (e.g.

arxiv-2312-02853.description: Abstract . We study the local theta correspondence for dual pairs of the form Aut ⁡ ( C ) × F 4 \mathrm{Aut}(C)\times F_{4} over a p p -adic field, where C C is a composition algebra of dimension 2 2 or 4 4 , by restricting the minimal representation of a group of type E E .

arxiv-2410-02508.title: Amplifying the antiferromagnetic spin Seebeck effect through topological magnons
arxiv-2410-02508.creator: Feodor Svetlanov Konomaev, Kjetil M. D. Hals
arxiv-2410-02508.description: Abstract Topological magnons emerge as topologically protected spin wave states at the edges of magnets. Here, we theoretically explore how these surface states can be harnessed to amplify the spin Seebeck effect (SSE) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) interfaced with normal metals (NMs).

arxiv-2503-14379.title: On the Standard Performance Criteria for Applied Control Design: PID, MPC or Machine Learning Controller?
arxiv-2503-14379.creator: Pouria Sarhadi
arxiv-2503-14379.description: Abstract The traditional control theory and its application to basic and complex systems have reached an advanced level of maturity. This includes aerial, marine, and ground vehicles, as well as robotics, chemical, transportation, and electrical systems widely used in our daily lives.

arxiv-2510-13851.title: EvoEdit : Evolving Null-space Alignment for Robust and Efficient Knowledge Editing
arxiv-2510-13851.creator: Sicheng Lyu Yu Gu Xinyu Wang Jerry Huang, Sitao Luan Yufei Cui Xiao-Wen Chang Peng Lu
arxiv-2510-13851.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) require continual updates to rectify outdated or erroneous knowledge. Model editing has emerged as a compelling paradigm for introducing targeted modifications without the computational burden of full retraining. Existing approaches are mainly based on a locate-then-edit framework.

pmc-11374021.creator: Soichiro Kubota, Shunichiro Hanai, Nakako Tanaka-Mabuchi, Ryosuke Ito, Daiki Nakagomi
pmc-11374021.description: omplement pathway [1]. It is a novel agent that may offer a glucocorticoid-independent therapy, considered essential for treating vasculitis. However, in practice, avacopan is often used in combination with cyclophosphamide or rituximab (RTX) to sustain remission in accordance with the ADVOCATE trial (NCT02994927) [2, 3].

pmc-11430613.title: Initial Experience with the New DERIVO® Mini Embolisation Device for the Treatment of Intracranial Aneurysms
pmc-11430613.creator: Sinan Balci, Ferdi Çay, Aycan Uysal, Anil Arat, Sherief Ghozy
pmc-11430613.description: The aim of this study is to present the outcomes of cerebral aneurysm treatment with the DERIVO® mini Embolisation Device (DMD), which is compatible with microcatheters with 0.021-inch inner diameters. Consecutive patients treated with DMD were identified retrospectively. Patient and aneurysm characteristics, procedural findings, clinical outcomes and follow-up imaging results were evaluated.

pmc-11656826.title: Recent advances in sarcoma therapy: new agents, strategies and predictive biomarkers
pmc-11656826.creator: Minggui Pan, Maggie Zhou, Lu Xie, Nam Bui, Kristen Ganjoo
pmc-11656826.description: Soft tissue and bone sarcomas are a heterogenous group of uncommon mesenchymal tumors with high unmet needs for novel therapeutic and diagnostic strategies. Despite many challenges that persist, innovative therapeutics are emerging. Here we provide a review of the studies presented at the 2024 American Society of Clinical Oncology annual meeting that were focused on sarcoma.

pmc-12524223.title: Effects of Clostridium butyricum on Physiological Parameters and Gut Microbiota in Newborn Hanwoo Calves
pmc-12524223.creator: Min Ji Kim, Young Lae Kim, So Hee Lee, Jong Suh Shin, Sang Kook Kim, Soo An Kim, In Gi Jo, Gyung Hyun Jo, Seong Jeong Han, Ki Deuk Bae, Eu Jin Ban, Byung Ki Park, Gabriella Holló
pmc-12524223.description: Simple SummaryClostridium butyricum possesses probiotic and metabolic properties. This study investigated the effects of C. butyricum on growth performance, gut microbiota, and various physiological parameters in Hanwoo calves. C. butyricum supplementation caused changes in blood amylase and acid–base parameters, suggesting improved metabolic stability and buffering capacity.

pmc-12555876.title: Adverse prognosis of GM-CSF expression in human cutaneous melanoma
pmc-12555876.creator: Elena García-Martínez, Alicia Nieto-Valle, Celia Barrio-Alonso, Baltasar López-Navarro, José Antonio Avilés-Izquierdo, Verónica Parra-Blanco, Alba Gutiérrez-Seijo, Paloma Sánchez-Mateos, Rafael Samaniego
pmc-12555876.description: BackgroundGM-CSF, a myeloid-priming cytokine, exhibits context-dependent effects on tumor growth and, despite its clinical use, its role in human melanoma remains undefined.MethodsA stage II-IV primary melanoma cohort (n = 80) was interrogated for GM-CSF/GM-CSFR expression at the single-cell level in tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) and tumor cells (TCs).

pmc-12853774.title: Mechanisms of ulnar collateral ligament injury in baseball: criteria and rationale for return to play — a systematic review
pmc-12853774.creator: Di Huang, William J Lew, Brent Shimoda, Eli M Snyder, Kai Sheng Khor, David X Cifu, Henry L Lew
pmc-12853774.description: Background and aimsReturn-to-play (RTP) readiness is a critical consideration for common baseball injuries, including after ulnar collateral ligament (UCL) injuries. UCL injuries, often resulting from repetitive throwing stress, can significantly impact an athlete’s career, requiring interventions ranging from nonoperative rehabilitation to surgical reconstruction. While RTP criteria for these injuries exist, they remain inconsistent across studies and clinical practice.

pmc-13043284.title: Large animal models for the assessment of snakebite envenoming therapies
pmc-13043284.creator: Melisa Benard-Valle, Shirin Ahmadi, Cassandra M. Modahl, Edgar Neri-Castro, Alejandro Alagón, Leslie Boyer, Anne Ljungars, Andreas H. Laustsen
pmc-13043284.description: Snakebite envenoming causes over 100,000 deaths annually, creating a need for more effective therapies. Traditionally, most preclinical testing relies on murine models with limited translational value. This review highlights the value of large animal models, particularly sheep and pigs, for studying venom toxicokinetics and antibody and small-molecule pharmacokinetics.

pmc-13061169.title: Antimicrobial resistance profiles and whole-genome sequence analysis of extended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL) production in commensal Escherichia coli from poultry in Türkiye
pmc-13061169.creator: Seyda Şahin, Büşra Gülay Celil Özaslan, Mahmut Niyazi Moğulkoç, Mehmet Karadağ, Jens Andre Hammerl, Mirjam Grobbel, Cemil Kürekci
pmc-13061169.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study examines phenotypic antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and its genetic background in Escherichia coli isolated from poultry flocks in Türkiye, with a particular focus on extended spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL)-producing strains. coli isolates obtained from ceacal samples of chickens (n = 745) and turkeys (n = 173) were subjected to antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the agar disk diffusion method.

pmc-13072819.title: From Strength to Dexterity: Clinically Meaningful Recovery of Upper Limb in Individuals with Cervical Spinal Cord Injury
pmc-13072819.creator: Federica Tamburella, Diego Piatti, Stefano Filippo Castiglia, Claudia Celletti, Giada Serratore, Giorgio Scivoletto
pmc-13072819.description: Background: Understanding the temporal relationship between neurological and functional recovery after cervical spinal cord injury (SCI) is crucial for optimizing rehabilitation timing and clinical interpretation. This prospective longitudinal study aimed to investigate the temporal dynamics of clinically meaningful neurological and functional recovery in individuals with subacute SCI during inpatient rehabilitation.

pmc-13159396.title: HRTEM Imaging and Mechanistic Insights Into Carbon Nanotube Nucleation and Growth on Fe Nanocatalysts in a Thermal Plasma
pmc-13159396.creator: Hengfei Gu, Stanislav Musikhin, Guangming Cheng, Nan Yao, Yevgeny Raitses, Bruce E Koel
pmc-13159396.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Thermal plasma decomposition of natural gas is a scalable pathway for the production of hydrogen alongside high‐value carbon nanotubes (CNTs). Metals evaporate from an electrode and condense to form seed nanoparticles that nucleate and grow CNTs. However, the lack of mechanistic understanding of the CNT nucleation and growth processes in thermal plasma makes control over CNT diameter, chirality, length, and yield difficult.

pmc-13225945.title: Improving Vancomycin Therapeutic Drug Monitoring With a Deep Learning–Based Two-Compartment Predictive Model: Development and Validation Study
pmc-13225945.creator: Bingyu Mao, Ziqian Xie, Laila Rasmy, Masayuki Nigo, Degui Zhi, Gang Luo
pmc-13225945.description: BackgroundVancomycin is a widely used antibiotic that requires therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) for optimized individual dosage. A deep learning–based model, pharmacokinetic recurrent neural network–1 compartment model (PKRNN-1CM), has shown the advantage of leveraging time-series electronic health record data for individualized estimation of vancomycin pharmacokinetic (PK) parameters.

pmc-13276138.title: Breast reconstruction in supernumerary breast and ectopic breast tissue in Poland’s syndrome
pmc-13276138.creator: Hüseyin Emre Ulukaya, Murat Doğuş Çerikan, Egehan Güngörmez, Mehmet Fatih Çamlı, Selami Serhan Şirvan, Kamuran Zeynep Sevim
pmc-13276138.description: BackgroundPoland’s syndrome is a rare congenital condition characterized by anterior chest wall malformations and, frequently, ipsilateral upper limb deformities. Treatment strategies vary depending on severity and may involve complex reconstructive approaches.Case presentationWe present the case of a 20-year-old female with Poland’s syndrome who exhibited left-sided supernumerary nipple and significant breast asymmetry.

pmc-13385179.title: Individualized repetitive intravenous immunoglobulin therapy for a 79-year-old patient with GlyR antibody-positive PERM: a case report and literature review
pmc-13385179.creator: Xiaojun Liu, Jianwei Zhu, Yuanhong Lei, Xinyuan Yu, Xiujuan Mi
pmc-13385179.description: Progressive encephalomyelitis with rigidity and myoclonus (PERM) is a rare, life-threatening variant of stiff-person spectrum disorder that is primarily associated with anti-glycine receptor (GlyR) antibodies. Although advanced age and intensive care unit admission have been associated with poor outcomes for patients with GlyR antibody-positive PERM, detailed management strategies for elderly patients with multiple comorbidities remain limited.

pmc-13431494.title: Genetic Evolution and Molecular Characterization of PRRSV GP5 in Germany
pmc-13431494.creator: Jiankun Pang, Qipeng Zhang, Chen Lv, Huawei Li, Xuyong Zhao, Ruining Wang, Keshan Zhang, Yaqiong Ye, Mengmeng Zhao
pmc-13431494.description: Simple SummaryPorcine reproductive and respiratory virus (PRRSV) causes significant economic losses in the German swine industry. Yet data on its main structural protein, GP5, have not been systematically analyzed in Germany. GP5 is a glycosylated envelope protein, which plays an important role in immune evasion.

pmc-13485192.title: Patients' Treatment Experiences With Orthodontic Fixed Appliances, Clear Aligners and Direct‐to‐Consumer Clear Aligners: A Qualitative Study—Part II
pmc-13485192.creator: Sherry Lee, Ben K. Daniel, Li Mei, Mauro Farella, Fiona A. Firth
pmc-13485192.description: AimUnderstanding the orthodontic patient experience is critical in providing enhanced patient‐centred care. Qualitative methods were employed to gain insight into the factors shaping an individual's orthodontic treatment experience.Objectives(1) To understand orthodontic patient experience regarding treatment progress, interactions with their treating practitioner and treatment outcome. (2) To explore the challenges patients faced during treatment.
